主要内容: On June 12, 2014, Nicholas Financial, Inc. terminated its Arrangement Agreement with Prospect Capital Corporation, which aimed to sell all its issued and outstanding Common Shares to an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Prospect. The termination was based on the inability to satisfy certain conditions by the deadline. The Board of Directors decided to retain Janney Montgomery Scott LLC as its independent financial advisor to evaluate strategic alternatives, including potential sale to Prospect or another third party, acquisition opportunities, and debt or equity financing. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Prospect (PSEC).
